tasks.subject: Task 1: Write docs/design-system.md and update CLAUDE.md
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Create the design system doc with all four sections, add it to CLAUDE.md, and commit.

**Files:**
- Create: `docs/design-system.md`
- Modify: `CLAUDE.md` — add `@docs/design-system.md` line after the existing `@colors_and_type.css` reference

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] `docs/design-system.md` exists with all four sections (Token Rules, Page Layout Pattern, _ui/ Component Reference, Anti-Patterns)
- [ ] `CLAUDE.md` has `@docs/design-system.md` under the Design system section
- [ ] No invented token names in the doc

**Verify:** `cat docs/design-system.md && grep design-system CLAUDE.md`

```json:metadata
{"files": ["docs/design-system.md", "CLAUDE.md"], "verifyCommand": "cat docs/design-system.md && grep design-system CLAUDE.md", "acceptanceCriteria": ["docs/design-system.md exists with all four sections", "CLAUDE.md references @docs/design-system.md"]}
```
